meta.title: Before we start: five questions
meta.subtitle: No Google, no ChatGPT, just your best guess. Completely anonymous.
meta.chimp_note: A chimpanzee picking answers at random scores 33 percent. Hans Rosling spent a career showing that educated audiences score worse than the chimps on these questions, because our picture of the world is decades out of date.

questions.text: In the last 25 years, the share of the world's population living in extreme poverty has...
options: Fallen by more than two thirds
questions.fact: It fell from 32 percent in 2000 to 9.3 percent today.
questions.source: SDG Index database, SDR 2026, indicator sdg1_wpc, World series

questions.text: How many of the world's one year old children have received at least their basic vaccinations?
questions.fact: 87 percent of infants worldwide receive basic vaccination coverage.
questions.source: SDG Index database, SDR 2026, indicator sdg3_vac, World series, 2024

questions.text: What is the average life expectancy of a person born in the world today?
questions.fact: World life expectancy reached 73.7 years in 2025, up from 67.6 in 2000.
questions.source: SDG Index database, SDR 2026, indicator sdg3_lifee, World series

questions.text: Out of every 10 people in the world, how many have access to electricity?
questions.fact: 91.7 percent of the world's population has access to electricity, up from 78 percent in 2000.
questions.source: SDG Index database, SDR 2026, indicator sdg7_elecac, World series, 2023

questions.text: Since 2000, the number of children dying before their fifth birthday has...
questions.fact: Under five mortality fell from 57 to 24.6 deaths per 1000 live births between 2000 and 2024.
questions.source: SDG Index database, SDR 2026, indicator sdg3_u5mort, World series
